notes: All 25 text files read in full. The 17 single-record pages are Krannert 'Distinguished PhD Alum' profiles captured in 2016: each gives only the person's name, current title and current institution (Woo's adds a short quoted CRS bio). They establish a Krannert doctorate but give no graduation year, PhD area or first placement, and the current affiliation must not be taken as the first job; areas span marketing, finance, strategy, accounting, MIS, OBHR and economics (Sonnenschein), so most fall outside operations. The kenneth-dunn.php page at the same path is headed 'Global Strategic Advisory Council', not 'Distinguished PhD Alum', and states no degree, so it is marked not-a-list; an integrator may want to confirm his Purdue PhD from another source before using it. The Krannert strategy placements page lists only hiring universities (no names). The two engineering.purdue.edu AAC pages (aerospace) and the Maha fluid-power theses page do list named PhD graduates with theses and, for AAC, first positions, but they are outside the operations/management population. Nothing suggests an institution other than the one given by host.
